Cup: 96.600 mm across flats, 30.000 mm tall
(base, 2 board-zone rings, floor, 6 pocket rings), 3 mm plywood.
The pocket holds up to 6 tokens; its floor is the baffle. The lid skirt is
6 rings deep, enough to cover the finger slots.
